outcome: Small for gestational age (SGA) babies <3rd centile
cohort: The study involved 111 women diagnosed with chronic histiocytic intervillositis (CHI) as cases, compared to 111 low-risk control women and a group of high-risk control women whose placentas were microscopically examined.
finding: Chronic histiocytic intervillositis (CHI) is a severe placental disease associated with a significantly increased risk of late miscarriages, severe small for gestational age (SGA), and in utero death, even when compared to high-risk pregnancies.
